column1: # Roland TB-3 profile v2 (P2-021), format of docs/design/hardware/HW_SUPPORT_LOWLEVEL.md 2.4 (v2: kind, link, per-param lane, wire sets).
# Own notes: written from the vendor's published MIDI chart (Roland, TB-3 MIDI Implementation v1.10, 2014-07-04) and the owner's by-ear tests of 2026-11-11 (decisions 104, 105, 106).

# All 11 CCs below were heard moving the named parameter on the owner's TB-3 (decision 106). CC 1, 11, 68, 69 are known from the owner's own test; nothing is read from docs/design/hardware/tb3-midi-guide.csv (midi.guide, CC BY-SA 4.0, reference only).
# Tags in docs/design/hardware/TB3_PROFILE.md. acc_mode 0 VEL / 1 CC / 2 NONE; slide_mode 0 OVERLAP / 1 CC / 2 NONE.
# layer: NONE NOTES HITS ACCNT ARTIC SHAPE. form: RAND WALK RAMP ACC for kind C; DICE BAR for kind S (SELECT).
# header: id name acc_mode acc_arg slide_mode slide_arg prov.src prov.how prov.cred prov.level prov.date
# params: cc lo hi home name kind link layer form move
#   kind: C = continuous; S<n> = SELECT, n equal zones over lo..hi (2..16); the zone count and edges are [I] until H-RIG20

#   link: - or the NAME of the partner; an optional :G (gated: the depth matters only when the type is not in zone 1 = OFF) and :R (resend the depth 1 ms after each type change) and :D (duck: depth 0, type, depth) follow; all three unknown and off until H-RIG20
#   layer form move: the lane this parameter gets when a wire takes it (a wire keeps what the player later changes); MOVE for a SELECT is the spread (0 = stay in the LEVEL zone)
# sets: set NAME p1 p2 p3 p4   (names of at most 5 letters; at most 6 sets; the first is what a freshly picked device starts with; every wire starts in HAND)
